outcome: OUTCOME 1 — TECHNICAL AND EVIDENCE READINESS VERIFIED, AUTHORIZATION PENDING

findings.title: Invoice Serial Length Strictly Limited to 16 Characters
findings.details: Full generated serial number must not exceed 16 characters under CGST Rule 46(b). With 7-char format overhead (/YY-YY/), prefix + sequence must be <= 9 chars.

findings.title: Allowed Character Set Enforced
findings.details: Enforces [A-Za-z0-9/-] per Rule 46(b). Prohibits spaces, underscores, dots, and colons.

findings.title: Section 134 Companies Act Scope Clarified
findings.details: Section 134 governs financial statement approval and internal controls. Prefix approval is an internal corporate governance policy, not an explicit statutory mandate of Rule 46.

findings.title: Order-to-Invoice Transaction Reconciliation
findings.details: 127 orders reconciled: 58 invoiced + 69 legitimately unbilled orders. Zero missing or duplicate order relationships.

findings.title: Invoice Inventory and Test Record Attribution
findings.details: 71 invoices reconciled: 58 customer order invoices + 13 synthetic concurrency test invoices from earlier phases. Preserved intact in cth_test baseline.

findings.title: Voucher 1004 and Ledger Integrity
findings.details: All 4 vouchers were created as INVOICE_DRAFT and never posted to GL. Voucher 1004 cancelled in Phase 3.7. GL balances 100% intact.
